sources: https://midnrreservations.com/ (Aloha State Park resources via /api/resourcelocation/resources?resourceLocationId=-2147483643, decoded with /api/attribute/filterable and /api/equipment)

values.note: DNR rate table, Aloha North, Middle and South Sections: modern 20/30-amp $41, 50-amp $46, full hookup $51-56. Sites temporarily without electricity rent at the semi-modern rate. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to all state park and forest campgrounds, on top of the camping fee.

fees.source: https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Aloha / North, Middle and South Sections: full-hookup $51 to $56, 50 AMP $46, 20/30 AMP $41) + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/aloha ('A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds'; 'These sites are available at the semi-modern camping rate'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/aloha ('All campsites in the south section are full-hookup sites with water and sewer connections'; 'Some campsites with 50-amp service') + midnrreservations.com resources (96 campsites 'Sewer Hookup: Yes', 'Water Hookup: Yes'; 87 list 50 Amps), read 2026-10-22

values.note: DNR lists 283 sites; the booking site has 287 campsites plus 20 overflow spots. 96 are full hookup (the south section), 87 have 50-amp service. Allowed rigs: 3 sites take over 50 ft, 3 to 50, 70 to 45, 103 to 40, 60 to 35, 38 to 30, 9 only to 25. No pull-throughs on the booking site.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/aloha ('Number of sites: 283') + midnrreservations.com resources (allowed equipment 'Trailer or RV up to N'' / 'over 50'', 'Pull Through: No' on every campsite), read 2026-10-22

values.note: No bathroom building in the south (full-hookup) section. Sanitation station at the campground entrance, two lanes, potable water. Campers may keep boats in the protected boat basin.

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/aloha ('Toilet & shower building', 'Modern campground', 'Concession or store'; 'There is no bathroom building in the south campground'; 'The park's sanitation station is located at the entrance of the campground. There is potable water available and two lanes.'), read 2026-10-22

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/aloha ('For reservations call 800-447-2757 or reserve online', linking midnrreservations.com), read 2026-10-22

note: Multiple sites are directly on the lakeshore with water views and lake access.  --AWH  As of October 2026 DNR reports campsites 1, 3, 5, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14, 16, 20, 21, 23, 25, 27, 29 and 54 without electricity (rented at the semi-modern rate, no generators) and sites 15, 18 and 19 closed for groundwater issues. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $41 (20/30-amp) to $56 (full hookup) with the Recreation Passport requirement, season May 15 - Oct 14 (already manual), reservable. Added 50-amp, water and sewer (south section full hookup), 283 sites (287 on the booking site) to 50+ ft with no pull-throughs, showers/flush toilets/sanitation station/potable water/store. --AWH note kept; added the dated partial-closure caveat (19 sites without power or closed). Pin checked on satellite: it sits on the campground road at the head of the boat basin, between the loops.
flags: Website is only the bare reservation home page (https://midnrreservations.com/); the park's own page is https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/aloha.
Phone missing: DNR gives the park phone 231-625-2522 (reservations 800-447-2757).
